However, option 'opb' is false; H. pylori is indeed related to the development of gastric lymphoma due to chronic inflammation caused by the infection. The transmission of H. pylori through oral-oral or fecal-oral routes is accurate, supporting option 'opc' as true. Additionally, lower educational levels and socioeconomic status are associated with higher rates of H. pylori colonization, validating option 'opd' as true. Lastly, the incidence of gastric adenocarcinoma is higher in patients with H. pylori, making option 'ope' true as well. Therefore, the false statement is option 'opb'.
